name: video_editor
title: Event video editor
description: A five-step editor for event films - marriage, engagement, party, baby shower and more. Finds the moments, orders them, cuts them to the beat of a song, reads the mood of each one, and renders the film. Stores references, never copies: only the finished film is written.

destructive_operations: render overwrites its own output file

pipeline.title: Choose the moments
pipeline.notes: auto scans for shot changes and loud moments; manual takes typed in/out points

pipeline.title: Decide the running order
pipeline.notes: cuts are scored by 64-bit difference hashes of the edge frames

pipeline.title: Cut to the beat
pipeline.notes: tempo by autocorrelation of the onset envelope; clip lengths rounded to whole beats

pipeline.title: Read the mood
pipeline.notes: heuristic measures light, motion and sound - not faces; face needs `pip install fer`

pipeline.title: Make the film
pipeline.notes: cuts from the original sources, so the film is encoded exactly once

target_minutes.description: How long the finished film should be.

scene_threshold.description: Scene-change sensitivity. Lower finds more moments.

min_gap_seconds.description: Minimum separation between two chosen moments, so the film does not take six clips from the same minute.

min_clip_seconds.description: Shortest clip the detector will propose.

max_clip_seconds.description: Longest clip the detector will propose.

snap.description: What musical unit cuts are rounded to.

audio_mode.description: What the finished film sounds like.

crf.description: Output quality. 18 is high, 28 is small.

backend.description: How the mood of a clip is judged.

presets.format: one JSON file per kind of event
presets.extensible: drop in another JSON file; no code change is needed

limits: The heuristic mood backend measures brightness, motion and loudness. It does not read faces, and it will misfile a sad moment shot in bright sunlight.
Beat detection needs a periodic pulse. Free-tempo music, speech or a solo instrument produce a weak result, which the tool reports rather than hides.
The beat grid is rigid, so a live recording that drifts in tempo will drift off the grid late in a long film.
Automatic moment finding uses picture change and loudness as proxies for interest. It does not know what is happening in the frame.
